title: Grubmaw Scavenger
text: Grubmaw Scavenger chews through abandoned packs and lunges at anything trying to recover them. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It prefers buckles, but it will settle for fingers.

defeatReward.text: Grubmaw Scavenger is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
